name: repository-explorer
description: Build a self-contained, static Repository Explorer for any repo: a browsable Markdown documentation site with a file tree, search, and a review/commenting layer, plus a code-verified Architecture & Technology analysis published as both Markdown and expressive HTML with hand-authored inline-SVG diagrams (and rendered mermaid). Browse the docs, then read an honest, source-linked walkthrough of how the system actually fits together.
